about: Quasi-static 2D field solutions (lossless) of hforsten's solver (Ttl/js_2d_fields, GPL-3.0) run locally on 2026-10-07 as a reference only: numbers, no code. Lengths mm; t = 0.0001 stands in for a zero-thickness strip (the solver needs t > 0). Coplanar grounds are infinite with a via fence at max(0.5, 2h) from the gap; the mask in coated_microstrip is conformal (c over laminate, trace top and sides).
